title: John Lennon attends Rolling Stones party | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono attended a party thrown by The Rolling Stones on 30 March 1971.

The band was due to relocate to France the following day to avoid the tax burden in the UK. Their farewell party was held at the Skindles Hotel in Maidenhead, England. Others in attendance included Eric Clapton, The Who’s Roger Daltrey, photographer David Bailey, and Dave Mason.
